title: Select a currently authorized visible Incident/Task row without changing the canonical Command Work Queue route
goal: Deliver CAP-CMD-101 Class-0 row selection and limited owner-authorized selected context on the existing Command route. Preserve current view/status/sort, prevent denied or off-page object disclosure and do not create an Inspector, Incident Detail provider, mutation or Saved View.
invariants: One existing GET /command/work-queue route, six canonical views; selected=Kind:ID is only an untrusted selection hint, never a permission or second route.

Only after resolving fresh SessionScope and Project's full Owner.CanRead checks, select an exact row in the currently authorized filtered/sorted first 50 rows; unavailable/denied/out-of-page selectors all return generic 404 with zero row data.

HTML uses a same-route GET button per visible row within the existing status/sort form and retains view/status/sort on selection; six view links retain filters/sort, selection is cleared on a different view.

Without a selector, JSON projection remains unchanged, including the absence of selected field; selection includes only a previously authorized Row and never canonical Incident Detail/Inspector or source link content.
No new Owner.List or CanRead calls, no arbitrary object lookup, Saved View persistence, unsafe action, new route, external API or new product runtime dependencies.
security_properties: Bad/repeated/overlong/control or invalid UTF-8 selected tokens and scope injection rejected before session/owner access.
All current object ACL/tenant/environment checks precede selector resolution; denied or off-page object IDs reveal no metadata or separate authorization oracle.
Selections are forgotten across independent requests and cannot be used to skip future authorization or page limits.
HTML contextual escaping from html/template, no-store, nosniff, CSP form-action self/frame blocked; no scripts.
On revoked owner or session, no selected object or partial response is returned.

migration.rationale: Opt-in read-only selected parameter and omitempty response field; no stored schema change.

rollback.strategy: Remove selected parameter parsing, optional Result.Selected and row form buttons while retaining parent Work Queue sort/status behavior.
verification: Existing six views and same route remain readable
No extra owner calls or Saved View mutations

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 §§1–27 and 03-design-system pattern selection-and-inspection, with ownership of Incident/Task in Command and Inspector in Design System.
Parent E10-CMD-101E-SORT on immutable SHA 502c7e8398c194d320ea234902cceaabd274d234; runtime run 39366010942 SUCCESS and engineering-kernel run 39366010979 SUCCESS. L2 parent separately pending.
Existing Go Work Queue Project, SessionResolver/Owner, bounded first 50 rows and same-route native HTML GET form.
outputs: Opt-in selected Row JSON field emitted only after fresh ACL and exact current page match; unselected JSON remains backward-compatible.
Accessible same-form row-selection action with selected context containing only already-authorized row fields; current view/filter/sort retained.
No actual Incident Detail or Inspector; no selected persistent state nor linking to Case/Run.
acceptance_tests: Request selecting an authorized visible Task in a filtered oldest-first view gives exactly that Row, while Project calls Owner.List once and CanRead once per in-scope candidate.
Select denied/foreign/wrong view or status/off-page item: generic 404 with no object data; session/owner errors still yield no partial response.
Invalid/duplicate/overlong/UTF-8/control selection fails 400 before session or owner; unsupported client-scope filters still rejected.
HTML selection button remains on one existing GET route, safely escapes malicious IDs, preserves view/filter/sort, and adds no extra system views or new Inspector.
Legacy requests keep original JSON field set; complete Linux/macOS/Windows Go runtime CI and mandatory unchanged security/complexity checks on final SHA.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuse existing fully authorized 50-row bounded slice after one Project; selection scans at most 50 already rendered rows, no additional provider calls.
metrics: One Owner.List per request and existing CanRead per in-scope record
O(50) local selection scan with no additional sort or network action
50 displayed rows and 5000 owner candidate bound unchanged
